sentences.text: For a floating-rate personal loan to an individual sanctioned on or after 1 January 2026, a UCB shall not levy pre-payment charges, so there is no usual pre-payment penalty rate for this case.
The older RBI directions on foreclosure or pre-payment penalties were withdrawn or repealed and are no longer in force on the as-of date.

The UCB directions also say that foreclosure charges or pre-payment penalty are subject to extant instructions, which in this case are the no-charge instructions for floating-rate personal loans to individuals.

missing.searched: I searched the in-force UCB directions and RBI repeal/status findings for any permitted pre-payment penalty rate for floating-rate personal loans to individuals sanctioned in 2026, and found only a prohibition on levying pre-payment charges.
